beats.headline: Signed, Vrah
beats.text: Hunter Vrah. Mantis. One of the regulars who come every season, with a death count in the thousands by one attendant's reckoning, and she wears the heads of her kills. She is the Grand of Zockau. Her little sister was Xindy of the Dark Hive, the flier Crawler Carl blew out of the sky on the first night. Her note, knifed to his door: the hunters are protected from explosions now, the guards all worship Emberus, and his head is going home to her sister's grave. He writes a reply on it in pen and throws it back out the door.

beats.headline: Heads on the carapace
beats.text: Hunter Vrah, as featured in tonight's recap. She and a unit of four other mantis creatures swoop out of the air onto a cart on a heavily wooded trail and decapitate the crawlers riding in it. The five land and loot the bodies while the show runs a rapid-fire list of what they took. The heads of the two crawlers Vrah killed personally, both human, she affixes to her carapace by some method the broadcast does not explain.

beats.headline: A hunter camp in her family
beats.text: Hunter Akland, an accountant who works with soy crop shipping manifests, explains where hunters like him come from. Vrah's family runs a fantasy hunter camp, so people can pretend they are on the show. Once a cycle the Dream rent the whole moon out for their employees and family members to play. The best players win places in an army for the ninth floor. Akland did well, won a spot, and was then offered a great deal of money to come down to the Hunting Grounds instead. He was never supposed to be in real danger.

beats.headline: Her little sister
beats.text: Hunter Vrah's little sister was Xindy, killed by Crawler Carl on her very first hunt. Their mother is Circe Took, a minor hive queen, a mantis outside both the military and the Burrower clan: a former hunter, famous for a while, now a businesswoman who owns an amusement park and probably has ten thousand children. She is moderating Carl's panel. Carl's reasoning runs that if she has found a way to speak with her daughter, Vrah will know exactly where and when he goes back down.

beats.headline: Level 74, and one arrow
beats.text: Hunter Vrah, now level 74 and larger, lands on Carl's alarm trap outside the saferoom and deshrouds him. She informs him that he is livestock, and that when this hunt is done she will take her place in the birthing hall of Hive Home two. Then the heads on her shoulders bite her, and Carl rams an arrow of Enthusiastic Double Gonorrhea into her neck. Her carapace bursts into flames and she ejects into the sky. The cures are gelding or passing it on. A future hive queen is not about to do the first.

beats.headline: Burning in the hallway
beats.text: Hunter Vrah reaches the Zockau saferoom hallway limping, smoke rising from her crotch with an odour of burned cheese, crying out for Edict. She arrives in time to watch him throw a punch at Carl and be teleported away, naked, to the nearest mob nest. She has shed every head from her back, not only the ones Princess Donut reanimated, perhaps to be lighter. The flames go out, she heals, and the fire starts again. A saferoom does not protect against this. The cat recommends ointment.

beats.headline: Riding it out, with bets on
beats.text: Word at Carl's signing table: Hunter Vrah intends to ride the infection out, and CrawlCon attendees are actively betting on whether she will give in and cut it away, which would end her chance of being the next hive queen. Her mother, Circe Took, is said to have gone completely apeshit and to be on her way to the Earth system to do something about it, though it is too late for her to join the hunters. Carl tells every questioner that Vrah will be dealt with soon enough.

beats.headline: Her mother comes to cure her
beats.text: Hunter Vrah's condition, courtesy of Crawler Carl: gonorrhea, which for her kind, Crawler Princess Donut recalls, has only one cure. Her mother, Circe Took of the Dark Hive, has sponsored the god Diwata, who arrives on a five-minute timer, marks Carl, and rockets away without touching him. Carl and Katia Grim agree where she is going: to her daughter. Crawler Princess Donut asks whether Vrah will rip her own mother's head off. Carl does not know. The party assumes Vrah is back in play.

beats.headline: A present for Carl
beats.text: Vrah reaches the ballroom at a charge and stops an inch from Carl's face, mandibles working. She has a present for him, she says, and it is coming soon; he is not the only one who can bend the rules, and he will learn what it means to make an enemy of the Dark Hive. Carl asks whether they ban their enemies from the bumper boats. She promises a rematch, and swears that before the night is done she will wear his head on her back, and all his friends'.

beats.headline: Mongo and Kiwi
beats.text: Hunter Vrah has been removed from the Hunting Grounds by Mongo and Kiwi, in the all-out battle around the submerged castle. Two dinosaurs. It took two. Also logged from the same fight: Tsarina Signet's tattoos are now permanently alive, and an incomplete flesh golem of her mother has appeared, which Crawler Carl has put in his inventory. Do not ask me what he intends to do with it. I have stopped asking.
